summary.text: Austin Wolf is the Democratic candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A plumber and small business owner, he attended Yankton High School.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Wolf described himself as a plumber, small business owner and lifelong South Dakotan who owns Austin Wolf LLC and previously owned Lou's Plumbing in Tea.
He said he is not running to represent a political party but to represent the people of District 6.
Wolf listed his campaign messages as putting working families first, with attention to rising property taxes, housing costs and infrastructure strain, and "people over party."
He said he is most passionate about affordability, responsible growth and practical governance, and about supporting small businesses and the skilled trades.
